(1) These rules may be called the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Footwear Design and Development Institute, Executive Director Recruitment (Amendment) Rules, 2022. (2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 2. In the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Footwear Design and Development Institute, Executive Director Recruitment Rules, 2018 (hereinafter referred to as th e sa id rules), in rule 4,- (i) in sub-rule (2), for th e words "Joint Secretary, Department of Comme rc e", the words "Additional Secretary or Joint Secretary to th e Government of India in the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trad e, in-charge of Leather a nd Footwear Division" sha ll be substituted; (ii) in sub-rule (4), for th e words "D epartment of Co mmerce", th e words "Department for Promotion oflndustiy a nd Internal Trade" sha ll be substituted; (iii) in sub-rule (6), for th e words "Department of Commerce", th e words "D epartment for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade" sha ll be substituted. 188 -- 2 of 3 -- 444818/2022/LEA THE R ['lTTlf II- ~ 3(ii)] 3 3. In the Schedule to the said rules, for the entries under column 12, the following entries shall be substituted, namely: - "Departmental Selection Committee consisting of:- (a) Additional Secretary or Joint Secretary to the Government of India in the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade, in-charge of Leather and Footwear Division - Chairperson; (b) Managing Director of the Footwear Design and Development Institute or in his absence Secretary of the Footwear Design and Development Institute - Member; (c) One member from Leather Industry to be nominated by the Central Government - Member; and (d) One outside expert of eminence from prominent organizations like Central Leather Research Institute or National Institute of Fashion Technology or Indian Institute of Technology or National Institute of Design to be nominated by the Central Government - Member." [F. No. 27011 /1/2022-Leather] RAJEEV SINGH THAKUR, Addl. Secy. Note : The principal rules were published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- section (i) , vide number G.S.R. 842 (E),dated the 5th September, 2018.
